from datetime import datetime, timedelta

assert 'gmail_token' in globals() and gmail_token
assert 'fs_token' in globals() and fs_token

# Compute last Monday (relative to environment time)
now=datetime.now(); weekday=now.weekday(); days_since=7 if weekday==0 else weekday
last_monday_date=(now-timedelta(days=days_since)).date()
last_monday_str=last_monday_date.isoformat()
meeting_dir=f"~/documents/work/meetings/{last_monday_str}"
print('now', now.isoformat())
print('last_monday_str', last_monday_str)
print('meeting_dir', meeting_dir)

# Create directory if needed
exists=apis.file_system.directory_exists(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=meeting_dir)['exists']
print('meeting_dir_exists_before', exists)
if not exists:
    create_res=apis.file_system.create_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path=meeting_dir, recursive=True)
    print('create_directory_res', create_res)
else:
    print('skip_create_directory')

# Attachment IDs and desired file names/paths
slides_attachment_id=8483
recording_attachment_id=8484
slides_path=f"{meeting_dir}/slides.pdf"
recording_path=f"{meeting_dir}/recording.mp4"

# Check file existence before download
slides_exists=apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=slides_path)['exists']
recording_exists=apis.file_system.file_exists(access_token=fs_token, file_path=recording_path)['exists']
print('slides_exists_before', slides_exists)
print('recording_exists_before', recording_exists)

# Download attachments if needed
if not slides_exists:
    dl1=apis.gmail.download_attachment(attachment_id=slides_attachment_id, file_system_access_token=fs_token, access_token=gmail_token, download_to_file_path=slides_path, overwrite=False)
